title: Close-out: the proposed fix corrects the off-by-one and removes the early return that made a limit of 0 mean unlimited

planted.why: with the early return removed, limit 0 gives used < 0, which is never true: every enterprise plan is blocked on its first request

proof.shell:
W=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r base/. $T/ && cd $T && patch -p1 -s < $W/change.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
from ratelimit import within_limit
assert within_limit(10, 10) is True, "F1 is real before the fix (11th request allowed)"
assert within_limit(10**6, 0) is True

PYEND
patch -p1 -s < $W/fix.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
from ratelimit import within_limit
assert within_limit(10, 10) is False, "F1 fixed"
assert within_limit(5, 0) is False, "limit 0 (unlimited) now blocks everything"

PYEND
